description: Move participants in your GrowSurf program to a group, or to Default with `groupId: null`. Each entry in `participants` is a GrowSurf participant ID or an email address (mixed lists are allowed), up to 200 entries per request. All found participants move together: if the move fails, no one moves. A move is a manual placement, so the groups' email and domain rules do not override it later. A move applies to new referrals only; rewards already earned keep their amounts. Returns a `summary` (total, groupId, movedCount, notFoundCount, duplicateCount, errorCount) plus per-row `results` in request order, each with `status` MOVED, NOT_FOUND, DUPLICATE, or ERROR. Targets `campaignId` if you pass it, otherwise GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID.

campaignId.description: Target program id for this call: the `id` returned by `growsurf_list_campaigns`, not the program name or a share URL. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Program IDs also identify newly created programs without restarting the server.

groupId.description: The group to move them to (`grp_…`), or `null` for Default. Required.

participants.description: GrowSurf participant IDs and/or email addresses to move (1-200 entries; mixed lists allowed).

items.description: A GrowSurf participant ID or an email address.

name: growsurf_bulk_move_participants

outputSchema.description: Bulk move outcome. A `200` can include `NOT_FOUND`, `DUPLICATE`, or `ERROR` rows, so check the summary.

results.description: One entry per submitted identifier, in request order.

email.description: The resolved participant's email. Present on `MOVED` rows.

identifier.description: The submitted participant id or email, echoed back.

index.description: Zero-based position of this entry in the submitted list.

participantId.description: The resolved participant id. Present when the entry resolved.

duplicateCount.description: Entries that resolved to the same participant as an earlier entry.

errorCount.description: Entries that failed to look up.

groupId.description: The target group, or `null` for Default.

movedCount.description: Entries that resolved to a participant and were moved.

notFoundCount.description: Entries that did not match any participant.

title: Bulk Move Participants
